races.name: Dundalk Stadium Group Deals Available Apprentice Optional Claiming Race
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This 7f contest lacks a genuine front runner, with four horses wanting prominent positions creating a recipe for false pace. The Liffey shows most versatility up front but lacks commitment as a true leader, while Dontspoilasale, Thaloria, and Suerte all prefer tracking the pace rather than making it. Expect these four to jostle for position early before settling in a line, creating moderate fractions through the first half-mile. The lack of genuine speed means this becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole, with the final furlong decisive. Draw positions will be crucial for avoiding the inevitable traffic problems when four prominent runners and four hold-up horses converge in the straight.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**Winners:** The Liffey benefits most from this scenario - her versatility allows tactical speed to secure position while her even-pace profile suits the sprint finish perfectly. Dontspoilasale's prominent style with even-pace running matches the projected tempo. Una Matata could be ideally placed as the classiest hold-up horse in a falsely-run race where strong finishers get their chance.

**Losers:** Benavente, Ruff Justice, and Crest Of Light face major concerns - all three are hold-up horses who need strong pace to set up their runs, but this false pace scenario offers little help. Thaloria risks being caught in the prominent congestion despite preferring to be handy. Going concerns center on Benavente, Ruff Justice, Thaloria, and Suerte - all are completely going-dependent on Good ground, making any track changes critical.

## RACE SCENARIOS

**A)** If The Liffey takes genuine hold of the lead early... The Liffey and Una Matata benefit because stronger pace allows Una Matata's hold-up style to be more effective while The Liffey can use her versatility to control the tempo.

**B)** If the prominent quartet creates severe early congestion... Una Matata and Crest Of Light benefit because they can avoid trouble by tracking from the rear before unleashing late runs on cleaner ground.

**C)** If one of the hold-up horses shows early tactical speed... Benavente and Ruff Justice benefit because if either breaks their usual pattern to sit closer, they avoid the inevitable traffic jam while maintaining finishing punch.

## WATCH POINTS

The four going-dependent horses - Benavente, Ruff Justice, Thaloria, and Suerte - need immediate scratching if conditions change from Good. Traffic will be brutal with four prominent horses creating a wall across the track. The Liffey's draw position is crucial for establishing early position without getting trapped. Una Matata needs the widest possible route in the straight to utilize her class advantage. Watch for Dontspoilasale potentially being squeezed out despite wanting prominent position - her rider needs to be aggressive early to secure racing room.

races.name: New Saddle Bar At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race lacks a genuine front runner, creating a false pace scenario. Bishopton, Musical Act and Venetian are the three prominent runners who'll contest early positioning, but none are natural wire-to-wire types. With four confirmed hold-up horses sitting off the pace, expect a dawdling gallop through the middle sections before a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs. The three prominent horses will likely go steady early as none wants to do the donkey work, setting up a finish that strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position handily without being overdone. At Dundalk's 7f, draw positions matter less than positioning just off the lead.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**Winners:** Bishopton sits perfectly for this scenario - prominent early without needing to lead, with the tactical speed to cover moves late. Musical Act also benefits from being able to sit handy in the false pace then use his finishing kick. Spinning Around, despite limited runs, has shown ability from both prominent and hold-up positions, giving tactical flexibility.

**Losers:** The confirmed hold-up quartet face a nightmare scenario. Blue Anthem, Um Wadi, Nikki Swango and Whistling Jamesie all need a genuine gallop to be effective, but will face a wall of horses sprinting in the final quarter-mile. Nikki Swango is particularly vulnerable as a going-dependent hold-up horse in a falsely-run race - needs everything to fall right.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Bishopton takes a stronger lead than expected... Musical Act and Venetian benefit because they can sit in his slipstream and use their finishing kicks in a more genuinely-run race.

B) If the pace collapses completely in the middle sections... Spinning Around benefits because of tactical versatility and even-pace profile, while the pure hold-up horses like Um Wadi and Whistling Jamesie get buried.

C) If one of the hold-up horses gets an early prominent position... Blue Anthem benefits because has shown front-running ability (3 leads from 9 runs) and could steal a march on the field if allowed easy fractions.

## WATCH POINTS

Nikki Swango requires close pre-race inspection - this going-dependent performer has never run on anything but Good ground and faces the worst possible pace scenario for a pure hold-up horse. Watch how aggressively the three prominent runners go early - if Musical Act or Venetian show urgency from the gates, it could create the genuine gallop that transforms this race. Blue Anthem's positioning will be crucial - if connections try front-running tactics rather than hold-up, he becomes significantly more dangerous in this weak pace scenario.

races.name: Sunday 12th July Ladies Day At Dundalk Handicap
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

Son Of Wind is the sole genuine front runner in this 15-horse field, creating a sustainable early pace without pressure. Jazzy Dancer, Comfort Line, Manhattan Dandy, and Carrickfinn will track prominently behind, but none are aggressive enough to challenge Son Of Wind early. This sets up a controlled gallop through the first 5f, with the pace gradually building from halfway. With 10 hold-up horses including Roman Harry, Jasmine Affanalis, Winemaker, and Vibrato, expect a wall of horses coming from off the pace in the final 2f. The moderate early tempo favors those with tactical speed to position close enough, while pure hold-up horses face a traffic nightmare in a large field.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**Winners:** Winemaker sits perfectly positioned to capitalize - projects highest on ratings and has enough early pace (2 lead, 3 prominent runs) to avoid the hold-up scramble. Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line benefit from tracking Son Of Wind's uncontested lead, positioned to strike when the pace lifts. Son Of Wind himself gets dream conditions with no early pressure.

**Losers:** The pure hold-up brigade faces a nightmare scenario. Roman Harry (13 hold-up runs), Cosmic Force (13 hold-up runs), and Jasmine Affanalis (8 hold-up runs) will be caught behind walls of horses when the pace quickens. Vibrato and Son Of Wind carry going concerns - both are completely dependent on Good ground and any change hurts them significantly. Hot To Foxtrot lacks the pace to overcome positioning disadvantages in such a large field.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Son Of Wind sets genuine fractions from the start... **Winemaker and Jasmine Affanalis** benefit because their hold-up styles work best when early leaders fold, creating gaps late.

B) If the prominent quartet (Jazzy Dancer, Comfort Line, Manhattan Dandy, Carrickfinn) gets into a positioning battle behind Son Of Wind... **Roman Harry and Vibrato** benefit because the increased early pace sets up their deep closers perfectly.

C) If Son Of Wind falters or faces unexpected pressure... **Winemaker and Comfort Line** benefit because both have enough versatility to press forward and capitalize on a pace collapse.

## WATCH POINTS

Son Of Wind and Vibrato are completely going-dependent - any deviation from Good ground kills their chances instantly. With 15 runners, draw becomes crucial for the hold-up horses: Roman Harry, Cosmic Force, and Deep Vein need clean passages that may not materialize from poor draws. Watch for Winemaker getting squeezed early given his versatile style - jockey needs to commit to position. Manhattan Dandy and Carrickfinn lack the class to win but could cause interference if they race keenly in the prominent positions.

races.name: Mid-Week Easter Break Racing Wednesday 1st April Handicap
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race lacks genuine front runners and will develop into a falsely-run affair with a sprint finish. Numidia, Jazz Forever, Hobart, and Circus Act will vie for prominent positions early, but none wants to make the running. Jazz Forever has shown most inclination to lead (3/12 runs) but prefers to sit just off the pace. Numidia will likely track the leaders having shown consistent prominent tactics. This creates a tactical cat-and-mouse opening half-mile before the pace quickens approaching the final 3 furlongs. The absence of a genuine galloper means the hold-up brigade gets ideal conditions - Mephisto, Slowdownbarney, Desert Friend, Disco Boy, Black Soul, Deluca Chop, and Sarmiento Power can all settle and benefit from the anticipated sprint finish.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**Winners:** Mephisto sits perfectly positioned as the highest-rated hold-up horse in a race tailor-made for his style. Desert Friend's versatile prominent/hold-up style gives him options in the tactical battle. Slowdownbarney's pure hold-up approach (10/15 runs) should thrive in the sprint finish despite his modest projected rating.

**Losers:** Circus Act faces the worst of both worlds - his prominent style (9/11 runs) forces him to race keenly early, but he lacks the finishing kick for the sprint finish this pace will create. Jazz Forever's poor recent form suggests he'll struggle when the pace quickens late despite getting his preferred prominent position. Hobart shows poor going form (6/12 on similar ground) and his prominent style won't suit the tactical nature.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Jazz Forever or Numidia decide to make genuine running early... Deluca Chop and Sarmiento Power benefit because both stay well (B+ trip) and strong gallops suit their stamina-laden profiles over sprint finishes.

B) If the pace becomes truly crawling with all four prominent horses refusing to lead... Mephisto and Desert Friend benefit because they can position closer than usual while retaining their finishing kick for the inevitable dash.

C) If Circus Act uses his prominent style to dictate from the front... Black Soul and Disco Boy benefit because they get the strong pace their hold-up styles need to be effective rather than relying purely on sprint speed.

## WATCH POINTS

Watch Numidia's early positioning - if settled too far back, his prominent style suggests he needs to be handy to fire. Mephisto must avoid being trapped behind the wall of hold-up horses in the sprint finish. Hobart's poor going record (6/12 on similar) makes him vulnerable if conditions ride testing. Desert Friend's versatile style means watching his early positioning will telegraph connections' tactics. Slowdownbarney needs a clear run in the sprint finish given his pure hold-up approach.

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This is a tactical nightmare masquerading as a maiden sprint. With five unraced runners and only Lamar River showing hold-up tendencies, we have no confirmed early pace. Maria Quiteria, Arrowstock, Whammy, Belle Island and Brazilian Diva are complete unknowns regarding their preferred racing positions. The lack of proven front runners suggests this will drift early before exploding into a frantic sprint finish over the final two furlongs. Whichever horse shows natural tactical speed to secure the rail position without overexerting will hold a decisive advantage. The winner likely comes from a horse that can travel smoothly in the first three positions rather than one needing to weave through traffic late.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS:** Any of the five unraced runners (Maria Quiteria, Arrowstock, Whammy, Belle Island, Brazilian Diva) that show natural gate speed and tactical awareness benefit massively. In a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint, being handy without fighting for position is gold. Their equal projected ratings suggest ability levels are similar, making early positioning crucial.

**LOSERS:** Lamar River faces a nightmare scenario. As the only confirmed hold-up horse in a field with no pace guarantee, he could find himself impossibly far back when the sprint develops. His even-pace finishing profile won't cope with a sudden injection of pace from a dawdling tempo. His significantly lower projection (86.8 vs 107.7) compounds this positional disadvantage.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Maria Quiteria or Arrowstock show natural early pace and secure the rail... they control the tempo completely and can dictate when to inject pace, with tactical speed being decisive over pure finishing kick.

B) If the pace collapses completely with all five newcomers showing reluctance to lead... Lamar River could benefit from an unprecedented reverse in running style, getting closer than usual and using his experience advantage over the debutantes.

C) If Belle Island or Brazilian Diva demonstrate superior tactical speed from wide draws... they can sweep around the entire field in the straight, capitalizing on their fitness advantage while others are still learning their trade.

## WATCH POINTS

Draw positions will be critical for the five unraced runners - those drawn low have natural advantages securing the rail position early. Watch for any of Maria Quiteria, Arrowstock, Whammy, Belle Island or Brazilian Diva showing anxiety in the stalls, as debutante nerves could cost crucial early positions. Lamar River needs pre-race assessment - any positive body language suggesting sharper early pace could transform his chances. The lack of going data for all runners except Lamar River makes pre-race paddock inspection essential for condition assessment.

races.name: BAR 1 Betting "Join Our Weekly Rewards" Maiden
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race lacks any genuine front runner, with Wild Sapphire and Nelliestar the only horses showing prominent tendencies but neither truly committed to leading. Wild Sapphire has led just 0 times in 4 runs while showing prominent 3 times, suggesting reluctance to go forward. Nelliestar has prominent credentials (4 times in 7 runs) but projects poorly here. With 10 hold-up horses behind them, this creates a classic false pace scenario where the early gallop will be pedestrian, setting up a sprint finish from the 3-furlong pole. The lack of genuine pace-forcing will compress the field turning for home, making positioning and traffic navigation crucial on what should be Good ground at Dundalk.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS:** Wild Sapphire benefits most as the highest-rated horse (OR 82) that can sit handy without being pressured early in a slowly-run affair. Poet's Willow, despite the B- trip rating, has the class (OR 120) to overcome the tactical disadvantage if getting a clear run. Grecian Power can also capitalize from his hold-up style if the pace collapse materializes as expected.

**LOSERS:** The pure hold-up brigade face significant disadvantages. Tyraxes, Gaiety Girl, Pedro The Poet, and Siofra Beag all rely on strong gallops to set up their finishing kicks - a slowly-run race neutralizes their back-end speed. Mystic Bella's moderate projection (31.3) suggests current form issues that a tactical race won't resolve.

**GOING CONCERNS:** Gaiety Girl, Tyraxes, Mystic Bella, and Siofra Beag are all going-dependent having raced exclusively on Good ground - any deviation could expose them.

## RACE SCENARIOS

**A)** If Wild Sapphire or Nelliestar go forward more aggressively than expected... **Poet's Willow, Grecian Power** benefit because a stronger gallop will stretch the field and allow their class to show through better finishing kicks.

**B)** If the pace collapses completely into a 3-furlong dash... **Wild Sapphire, Bartolito** benefit because prominent positioning becomes decisive when there's no time for hold-up horses to wind up their challenges.

**C)** If traffic problems develop in the sprint finish... **Poet's Willow, Good Onya Mate** benefit because higher-rated horses with tactical speed can find cleaner passages while the hold-up merchants get shuffled back in the melee.

## WATCH POINTS

Monitor pre-race market moves on the going-dependent quartet - Gaiety Girl, Tyraxes, Mystic Bella, and Siofra Beag need the Good ground to hold. Watch for any positive vibes around Poet's Willow whose OR 120 rating towers above this field despite the trip concerns. In running, focus on how aggressively Wild Sapphire's connections instruct the jockey - if they sit too far back, they surrender their key positional advantage. The 10 hold-up horses create a bunching risk turning for home where clean passage becomes premium currency. Nelliestar's consistent prominent racing suggests she'll ensure some early pace, but her woeful projections indicate she'll fold when the serious business begins.

races.name: Next Friday Fixture At Dundalk 10th April Handicap
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race screams false pace and sprint finish. With no confirmed front runner, four horses — Rising Sky, On The Cards, Barretstown, and Rushford — all want prominent positions but none is a genuine pace-setter. Barretstown has the strongest leading tendencies (4 leads from 13 runs) but often settles prominent rather than dictating. This creates a bunched field through the early stages with modest fractions. The pace will be steady at best through the first mile, setting up a cavalry charge from the 2½ furlong pole home. With five hold-up horses including Captain Hanley, Storm Eric, and Star Mind waiting to pounce, this becomes a test of tactical positioning and finishing kick rather than sustained speed.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**Winners:** The hold-up brigade thrives here. Captain Hanley gets his ideal scenario — strong hold-up style with even pace perfectly suited to a sprint finish from off the pace. Storm Eric's 11 hold-up runs from 14 show he's most effective when produced late, exactly what this shape delivers. Star Mind, despite poor projected form, is a pure closer who needs this type of finish.

**Losers:** The prominent quartet face traffic nightmares. Rising Sky and On The Cards risk getting caught in the inevitable squeeze when four horses fight for limited front positions. Barretstown's prominent style could work if he can dictate, but more likely gets caught in the washing machine 3 out when the field bunches. **Key concern:** Palazzo Persico is going-dependent with all 15 runs on Good ground — any change from current conditions kills his chances completely.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Barretstown takes them along at genuine pace... Captain Hanley and Storm Eric benefit because their hold-up styles are perfectly positioned to strike when the early pace-setters tire in the final 2 furlongs.

B) If the pace collapses into a crawl... Rising Sky and On The Cards benefit because their prominent positions give them first jump on the sprint finish while the pure closers get caught too far back.

C) If prominent traffic creates interference 3 out... Star Mind and Storm Eric benefit because they're tracking furthest back with the clearest run while the prominent horses get shuffled and checked.

## WATCH POINTS

**Critical going check:** Palazzo Persico has run exclusively on Good ground — any deviation to Good to Soft or firmer makes him unbetable. **Traffic concerns:** With four horses wanting the same prominent spot, expect significant interference from 3 furlongs out as they fan across the track. **Tactical advantage:** Star Mind and Storm Eric should get the clearest runs from the back, while Captain Hanley's hold-up style gives him multiple route options when the sprint develops. **Positioning trap:** On The Cards and Rushford risk being caught between the early prominent battle and the late closers, potentially ending up in no-man's land.
